title: Caught In The Act: Tiger Showdown
original_title: Caught In The Act: Tiger Showdown
overview: Tigers are the largest feline predators on the entire planet. They will go to great lengths, even kill, in order to gain dominance over other males. That's the scenario that confronts filmmaker John Varty as two of his male tigers, Ron and Seatao, come head to head on his breeding ranch in South Africa. John captures raw footage of the tiger fight before he decides to...
